title: Ory Kratos LoopZero wrapper values schema
description: Plan v1.2 T2.5 / D4 — fail-fast on missing keys per ADR. Schema enforces uiBaseUrl pattern (no trailing slash per EC-8) and required-by-env override discipline.

uiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for Kratos UI redirects (login, registration, etc.). Anchored pattern: scheme http(s), FQDN-like host ([a-z0-9.-] starting with alnum), optional :NNNN numeric port. NO trailing slash (EC-8), NO query/fragment, NO userinfo (catches http://user:pass@host injection), NO non-numeric port (catches http://host:abc). Per env: dev/standalone/standalone-multi=http://localhost:4455; drill=https://app.loopzero-drill.example; prod=https://app.loopzero.example. Set via infra/helmfile/environments/<env>.yaml. (2026-05-20 pattern audit closed shadow bug class: old pattern '^https?://[^/]+(:[0-9]+)?\$' was too permissive — '[^/]+' greedy-matched any non-slash sequence including :abc, ?query, @userinfo.)

kratos.description: Upstream ory/kratos chart values pass-through. Schema does not constrain (delegates to upstream chart's own schema).
